tool_input.description: Verify row counts for all gold models
tool_input.sql:
SELECT 'dim_client' as model, count(*) as cnt FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_CLIENT
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_advisor', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ADVISOR
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_account', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ACCOUNT
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_security', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_SECURITY
UNION ALL SELECT 'fct_account_value', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE
UNION ALL SELECT 'fct_portfolio_return', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_PORTFOLIO_RETURN
